# Bench workflow acceptance fixture

Synthetic saved PCB created for v0.12.40 browser acceptance. TP1 is at (15,15) mm on GND; TP2 at (25,15) mm on +3V3. R1 is fitted and connected to both nets; R2 is explicitly DNI on the bottom side. No manufactured board or camera result is represented.

The local browser harness returns this source through mocked repository transport. Checks covered direct toolbar actions, combined testpoint search, same-net R1 pad navigation, assembly queue resume after reopening, disabled DNP progress and approximately 390 CSS-pixel phone cards. This does not establish installed-extension or physical-device acceptance.
